summary: The paper describes the atomic layer deposition (ALD) of zinc nitride (Zn3N2) thin films using diethylzinc (DEZ) and ammonia (NH3) as precursors. The study investigates the growth mechanism, self-limiting characteristics, and application of Zn3N2 in thin film transistors (TFTs). The films are polycrystalline with preferential orientation in the {321} direction and show promising performance as a channel layer in bottom-gate TFTs. The saturated growth rate is 0.9 Å per ALD cycle at 315 /C14 C.
